Alex Kuleshow, a Russian of the Luga district south of Leningrad, father of Zinaida,
born at Savice near Luga in 1916. He is named with his wife Evdochia in Zinaida's obituary of 2008.
Zinaida's mother, named in her obituary of 2008.
The Weener historian thinks Zinaida's mother was with the family in the railway wagon at Weener station in 1945,
so Evdochia was probably deported from the Luga district with them in 1943.
